description: This file provides support for capturing, formatting, and managing stack traces in Go, including stack frame retrieval, formatting, and pooling for efficiency.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Represents a captured stack trace, including program counters and frame information.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: Formats a stack trace into a human-readable string.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Captures a stack trace at a specified depth, with an option to skip frames.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the stack trace and returns it to the pool.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames in the stack trace.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next frame in the stack trace.

methods.name: Take
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current stack trace.

methods.name: NewFormatter
methods.description: Creates a new Formatter for formatting stack traces.

methods.name: FormatStack
methods.description: Formats all remaining frames in the stack trace into a string.

methods.name: FormatFrame
methods.description: Formats a single frame into a string.
